title: Publish the public GitHub repository
what: Use the account-scoped publisher to create or safely resume ownasquare/notedock and push main.
how: Never switch global GitHub auth; fail closed on any owner, name, origin, visibility, branch, or SHA mismatch.
test: The publisher returns a public URL, main as default, and matching local and remote 40-character SHAs.
validate: Keep local, GitHub publication, hosted deployment, provider, payment, usage, buyer, and commercial proof separate.
follow_up: Record the verified receipt in lane state before claiming publication success.

title: Close the registry and continuation handoff
what: Update the immutable app record, run record, app completion documentation, and canonical handoff with the GitHub receipt.
how: Remove only completed queue items and call complete-app only after the queue is empty and GitHub push proof is recorded.
test: Read back the final lane state, GitHub repository, local HEAD, remote HEAD, and clean app worktree.
validate: Keep local, GitHub publication, hosted deployment, provider, payment, usage, buyer, and commercial proof separate.
follow_up: Stop when no steps remain or preserve the exact terminal time-cap/blocker state.
